generated_from.method: static AST/JSON/TOML inspection; no package imports, model loads, network or credential lookup

notes: Catalogue support describes package interfaces, not pretrained scientific accuracy.
Install commands run from an authorized local OpenHisto package checkout; they do not assume a published PyPI release.
Examples require the caller-supplied inputs/artifacts noted in their comments and input contracts; they are not scientific training recipes.
MIL profiles and shared task heads run on CPU float32; fitted classical classifiers retain their own numeric policy.
Native MIL tasks and attached shared-head tasks are reported separately.
79 entries include datasets, normalization methods and heads as well as model backends.
Checkpoint access and license/use terms are separate; consult the linked source terms.

encoders.name: Amazon Nova Multimodal Embeddings
encoders.access_note: Provider credentials/entitlement required; selected patches are sent to the provider and requests may incur charges.
encoders.description: Official checkpoint preprocessing and one image per embedding; one vector per selected patch.
encoders.input_contract: Indexed patch-extraction HDF5 archive or explicit CSV/JSONL RGB patch manifest, with stable source/slide identities and magnification.
encoders.example:
from openhisto.feature_encoder import EncodeConfig, EncoderSpec, SourceSpec, encode_slide

report = encode_slide(
    inputs=[SourceSpec("patches/slide.h5", source_id="grid-20x")],
    output="features/slide.h5ad",
    models=[EncoderSpec('nova_multimodal')],
    config=EncodeConfig(slide_id="slide-a"),
)

from openhisto.mil.classification import create_neural_head
from openhisto.mil.heads import attach_head, representation_dimension

model = attach_head(backbone, head, train_backbone=False)

survival.name: Cox proportional hazards
survival.access_note: Local CPU float32 linear/MLP head. Fit with caller-supplied outcomes and use training-only baseline/grid calibration; no pretrained head is bundled.
survival.description: Linear/MLP log-relative-risk head; cohort risk-set loss with Efron/Breslow ties and training-only Breslow absolute-survival calibration.
survival.input_contract: CPU float32 slide embeddings[N,D]; finite nonnegative durations in a consistent unit; event=1 observed, event=0 right-censored.
survival.example:
from openhisto.mil.survival import create_survival_head

head = create_survival_head("cox", input_dim=768, network="mlp")
# After training, fit absolute-survival calibration on training data only.
head.fit_baseline(training_embeddings, durations, events, split="train")

survival.name: Discrete hazards
survival.access_note: Local CPU float32 linear/MLP head. Fit with caller-supplied outcomes and use training-only baseline/grid calibration; no pretrained head is bundled.
survival.description: Linear/MLP conditional-hazard logits on a training-fitted positive-width grid; explicit censoring/boundary/truncation semantics.
survival.input_contract: CPU float32 slide embeddings[N,D]; finite nonnegative durations in a consistent unit; event=1 observed, event=0 right-censored.
survival.example:
from openhisto.mil.survival import create_survival_head

head = create_survival_head("discrete_hazard", input_dim=768, network="mlp", num_bins=20)
head.fit_time_grid(training_durations, events, split="train")
